checks.description: All 15 narration and 14 dialogue WAVs load by cue ID
Opening voice uses the dedicated Voice bus
N01 starts its temporary narration take at the subtitle cue
Seeking within one cue does not restart the same voice take
Cinematic pause freezes the current voice take
B1 dialogue replaces the narration take
Leaving the opening stops the last voice take
Skipping a part clears voice before the next part begins
